content: It includes details about various studies, reviews, and clinical trials related to influenza, antiviral treatments, corticosteroids, and other related topics. Each reference contains the authors, title, journal, publication year, volume, issue, page numbers, and sometimes a DOI or other identifier. 1. J.W., Fletcher R.A., Langat P., Zambon M., Lackenby A., et al. conducted a study titled The mechanism of resistance to favipiravir in influenza, which was published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the USA in 2018. The study explored the molecular mechanisms underlying influenza virus resistance to the antiviral drug favipiravir. The findings were detailed in volume 115, pages 11613-11618, and can be accessed via DOI: 10.181134511540.
